items.title: Peter LaCaze Interview, 1972-01-27
items.q: Joseph Watson was a clarinet player. stuff He was from the Night Wars.

ctx.x: He was down there in the Ninth Ward sometimes? Yeah. Yeah.
But who were some of the musicians in the Ninth Ward? Well, we had, let's see if I can remember, well Maurice Duran was from the Ninth Ward, and Joseph Watson was a clarinet player. stuff

He was from the Night Wars. And let's see who else. Charlie Bernard, he played a ghetto. He was from the Night Wars. And there's another man, I don't know, let's talk about the nickname. We called him Joe Hoodoo. He used to play trombone.
